verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page says Pipelines can run CI/CD workflows on hosted or private runners, or both, with centralized visibility. It also says Bitbucket Cloud can connect to on-prem CI/CD tools like Jenkins or Bamboo. The evidence is a single marketing-level claim with no supporting depth. Missing for 10: detailed runner setup and configuration documentation (supported OS and architectures, registration, scaling), and independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted runner usage.
